= Admonitions and Source Blocks

NOTE: A paragraph admonition shorthand.

TIP: A tip with `inline code`.

IMPORTANT: Pay attention.

WARNING: Be careful.

CAUTION: Last warning.

[NOTE]
====
A block-style admonition with multiple paragraphs.

This is the second paragraph inside the same NOTE.
====

[WARNING]
A block-style attribute on a regular paragraph also flips it into
admonition rendering.

.A titled note
[TIP]
A titled admonition retains its supplied title instead of the default
label.
